recent: 公司于2026年11月20日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度的合并业绩。近期有多项董事及大股东权益变动申报，包括执行主席Yong Keang Cheun于2025年11月19日至21日期间在公开市场增持股份，以及独立非执行董事Eng Kim Haw于2026年9月3日减持股份。此外，公司已于2026年10月2日发布2025年年报及企业治理报告。

独立非执行董事Eng Kim Haw于2026年9月3日减持34,000股普通股。
公司于2026年10月2日发布2025年年报及企业治理报告。

recent_en: The company announced its consolidated quarterly results for the financial period ended 30 September 2026 on 20 November 2026. There were several recent notifications of changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including Executive Chairman Yong Keang Cheun acquiring shares in the open market between 19 and 21 November 2025, and Independent Non-Executive Director Eng Kim Haw disposing of shares on 3 September 2026. The company also released its Annual Report & CG Report 2025 on 2 October 2026.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Yong Keang Cheun acquired approximately 2.91 million shares in three tranches in the open market between 19 and 21 November 2025.
Independent Non-Executive Director Eng Kim Haw disposed of 34,000 ordinary shares on 3 September 2026.
The company released its Annual Report & CG Report 2025 on 2 October 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Eng Kim Haw disposed of 34,000 ordinary shares on 3 September 2026.
